title: Little Treat: Gemini focused
old_caption: Five chats down to one. Remembered the dog's name (Biscuit). Asked a talk card question and listened to the whole answer. Gemini, that's a sundae. What's your focus treat?

title: Little Treat: Pisces, shared
old_caption: Pisces cried at the movie only once, said no to a plan it didn't want, then cried happy tears on date one. So did the date. Two spoons, one pie. Who's your crying buddy?

title: Capricorn's Quarterly Feelings Review
old_caption: Capricorn really built a slide deck to say "every Sunday, same diner, you." Honestly? Approved. Which sign in your life would schedule a recurring date?

title: Virgo Runs the Sync
old_caption: "Quick sync?" means I miss you. "Circle back" means I need a minute. Virgo translated, finally. What's the most corporate thing you've ever texted a crush?

title: Gemini's All-Hands Apology
old_caption: Gemini looped in stakeholders (the best friend) and then took full ownership. Growth, presented in slides. Tag the friend who apologizes like a press release.

title: Libra Tables the Motion
old_caption: Libra tabled dinner, pushed the label to next quarter, then went first on feelings. A full arc in one meeting. Which sign takes longest to pick a restaurant?

title: Scorpio's Deep Dive
old_caption: Scorpio's deep dive starts at your childhood and ends at "I want to meet your best friend." Intense? Yes. Into it? Also yes. Who's your Scorpio?

title: Cancer and the Different Goodnight
old_caption: Cancer built an entire case file over a star instead of a moon. The answer was: they fell asleep. Be honest, how many exhibits have you made over one text?

title: Aries Texts First (Again)
old_caption: Aries presented three exhibits and the jury said send it. Waiting around was never the plan. Are you a text-first sign or a wait-and-see sign?

title: Aquarius's Planetarium Date
old_caption: Aquarius walked the group chat through why a dark room full of nebulas is peak romance. By exhibit C, the couch was crying. What's your nerdiest dream date?
